7 انزجر and ↓ اِزْدَجَرَ He, being chidden, by a cry, by the voice, or by reproof; or being checked, restrained, or forbidden, with rough speech; (TA;) or being prevented, hindered, restrained, or withheld; or being forbidden or prohibited; refrained, forbore, or abstained; (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K, TA;) عَنْ كَذَا from [doing] such a thing. (Mgh, TA.) ―
-b2- ↓ ٱزْدُجِرَ , in the Kur liv. 9, means He was driven away. (TA.) ―
-b3- انزجر He (a dog) became urged, or incited, by a cry, to pursue the game. (Mgh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
